analysis.headline: Apple's 'Welcome Home' event launches HomeView, refreshed Apple TV 4K and HomePod mini
analysis.summary: At its October 13 'Welcome Home' event, Apple launched the $299 HomeView smart display, a refreshed Apple TV 4K with hands-free Siri microphones, an updated $149 HomePod mini, and the Apple Home Collection of smart-home accessories made with LG and Schneider Electric, after earlier reports named only LG. Outlets disagree on whether the HomePod mini's Siri AI works at launch or arrives later.
